queries.sql:
<![CDATA[select 
hp_org.party_number org_party_number,
hp_org.party_id org_party_id,
hca.account_number acct_vendor_number, 
hca.account_name acct_vendor_name,
hca.cust_account_id cust_acct_vendor_id,
hp_person.PERSON_FIRST_NAME PERSON_FIRST_NAME,
hp_person.PERSON_LAST_NAME PERSON_LAST_NAME,
hp_person.party_id person_party_id,
:p_party_type party_type
from HZ_CONTACT_POINTS hcp
, HZ_CUST_ACCOUNT_ROLES hcar
, HZ_CUST_ACCOUNTS hca
, HZ_PARTIES hp_org
, HZ_PARTIES hp_person
where hp_org.party_id=hca.PARTY_ID
and hca.CUST_ACCOUNT_ID=hcar.cust_account_id(+)
and hcar.contact_person_id=hcp.owner_table_id(+)
and hcar.contact_person_id=hp_person.PARTY_ID
and hcp.contact_point_type='EMAIL'
and hcp.email_address=:p_email
and :p_party_type='CUSTOMER'
UNION
select 
hp_org.party_number org_party_number,
hp_org.party_id org_party_id,
ps.segment1 vendor_number,
hp_org.party_name vendor_name,
ps.vendor_id,
pasc.PERSON_FIRST_NAME PERSON_FIRST_NAME,
pasc.PERSON_LAST_NAME PERSON_LAST_NAME,
pasc.PER_PARTY_ID  person_party_id,
:p_party_type
from hz_parties hp_org,
poz_suppliers ps,
POZ_ALL_SUPPLIER_CONTACTS_V  pasc
where 1=1
and ps.party_id=hp_org.party_id
--and ps.segment1='ZHRUCO'
and :p_party_type='SUPPLIER'
and hp_org.party_id=pasc.SUP_PARTY_ID 
and pasc.email_address=:p_email]]>

<![CDATA[SELECT
    ith.header_number            tonumber,
    wnd.attribute12              masterbol,
    wnd.delivery_name            shipmentnum,
    substr(wnd.attribute9, 1, 3) vesselname,
    wnd.status_code
FROM
    inv_transfer_order_headers ith,
    inv_transfer_order_lines   itl,
    wsh_new_deliveries         wnd,
    wsh_delivery_assignments   wda,
    wsh_delivery_details       wdd
WHERE
        1 = 1
    AND ith.header_id = itl.header_id
    AND itl.supply_order_reference_number = :p_so_num
    AND itl.supply_order_ref_line_number = :p_so_line_num
    AND wnd.delivery_id = wda.delivery_id
    AND wda.delivery_detail_id = wdd.delivery_detail_id
    AND wdd.sales_order_number = ith.header_number
    AND wdd.sales_order_line_number = itl.line_number
    AND wdd.source_line_type = 'TRANSFER_ORDER'
UNION
SELECT
    NULL                         tonumber,
    wnd.attribute12              masterbol,
    wnd.delivery_name            shipmentnum,
    substr(wnd.attribute9, 1, 3) vesselname,
    wnd.status_code
FROM
    wsh_new_deliveries       wnd,
    wsh_delivery_assignments wda,
    wsh_delivery_details     wdd
WHERE
        1 = 1
    AND wnd.delivery_id = wda.delivery_id
    AND wda.delivery_detail_id = wdd.delivery_detail_id
    AND wdd.sales_order_number = :p_so_num
    AND wdd.sales_order_line_number = :p_so_line_num
    AND wdd.source_line_type = 'SALES_ORDER']]>
